page_contract.claim: 机械钟不会一下走完，因为摆轮和擒纵叉让擒纵轮每次只释放一个齿距，然后由另一块锁瓦再次锁住。
page_contract.relationship: Four-state authored mechanism sequence with a stable procedural Three.js assembly and projected SVG callouts.

author_layer.reason: Only the page composition and procedural mechanism implementation are authored sample source.

size.decision: Readable-compact full source; no minification, geometry removal, precomputation or static substitution.

preserved_mechanism.geometry: The 15-tooth escape wheel, fork/pallet silhouettes, balance wheel, 230-sample spiral, torque/impulse/motion paths, materials, lighting, camera, shadows and all dimensions are unchanged.
preserved_mechanism.interpolation: The same cubic ease, per-field linear interpolation, 700/740 ms transitions and 360/680 ms authored playback cadence remain.
preserved_mechanism.copy: All title, state copy, component labels, readings, control labels and fallback description are unchanged.

changes: Compacted CSS to one readable rule per line and removed indentation-only source cost without changing declarations or DOM.
Split the longest 487-character token declaration into semantic color and typography groups; the final author-source maximum is 245 characters without adding CSS behavior.
Made canonical states, color roles, DOM references and resource collections explicitly immutable.
Replaced repeated getElementById paths with a named byId helper and grouped related runtime ownership.
Used default parameters and property shorthand in material/geometry records without changing numeric inputs.
Centralized abort-owned event registration through listen().
Added lostpointercapture recovery and explicit capture/drag-state cleanup during destroy.
Gated every public mutator after destroy and exposed disposed state, preventing post-pagehide DOM or mechanism changes.
Centralized graphics ownership so normal destroy and partial Three.js construction failure both release every already-created geometry, material, renderer and WebGL context.
Released the global mechanism API on destroy so it cannot retain the disposed Three.js scene closure.

equivalence.screenshots: The original 12 baseline/candidate pairs and the current nine independently regenerated fixed-state pairs all have pixel AE 0.
equivalence.structure: Across the current nine fixed states, canonical public state, titles, copy, readings, timeline/fill values, active beat indices, canvas dimensions and projected callouts match baseline exactly. Object transforms, 63 procedural geometry signatures, 23 material signatures and camera projection also match exactly across 102 scene objects.

risks: At 45,820 author characters this remains a full primary sample and will require a separate mini if used as an auxiliary sample.
The lifecycle contract intentionally rebuilds the WebGL scene on page reload rather than remounting disposed GPU resources in place.
Fallback SVG behavior remains unchanged and depends on the existing WebGL failure branch.

resource_ownership.strategy: relative symlink to the formal sample's unchanged shared chassis/vendor directory

findings: The prior report described broad browser coverage but persisted no executable browser test, so its assertions could not be independently rerun.
cleanup disposed resources but left window.__escapement retaining the complete scene closure.
If Three.js initialization threw after renderer construction, catch nulled renderer before cleanup and leaked the partial renderer/context until navigation.
Three.js shape parameter objects contain run-specific identities; the saved audit hashes actual indexed attribute buffers and topology rather than unstable UUID-bearing metadata.
staging_fixes: Added a single releaseGraphics owner used by partial-construction failure and final cleanup.
Destroy now marks the renderer disposed, releases the global API only when it owns that binding, and leaves retained public mutators inert.
Split the only 487-character CSS token line into semantic groups to keep the source genuinely readable rather than merely compact.
Added a reproducible cross-audit harness and current screenshots without changing any authored mechanism state, geometry, material, camera, copy, input or animation timing.
